title: How Much of a Member's Crop Input Spend Subscribes Capital to Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
Crop input spend only subscribes capital where the cooperative has actually been paid for it, so the spend counts by how the member's buying account stands on their Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| How the member's crop input accounts stand | Share of the crop input spend that counts |
| --- | --- |
| a crop input account standing past due with a balance still standing on it | 0.0 of it; none of the crop input spend counts |
| a crop input account standing active and the balance standing on it above the limit that account carries | 0.5 of it; half of the crop input spend counts |
| neither of the above | the whole of the crop input spend counts |

**The first line in both its limbs.** An account must stand past due and a balance must still stand on it. A past-due account carrying no balance does not reach the first line.

**The second line in both its limbs.** An account must stand active and the balance standing on it must be above the limit that account carries. A balance exactly at the limit is not above it, and the second line does not hold.

## Points of judgement on hypothetical figures

| Past-due account and balance | Active account balance | Limit the active account carries | Share that counts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| past due, 4200.00 standing | 1500.00 | 20000.00 | 0.0 |
| no past-due account | 26000.00 | 20000.00 | 0.5 |
| no past-due account | 20000.00 | 20000.00 | the whole |
| no past-due account | 12000.00 | 20000.00 | the whole |
| past due, nothing standing | 26000.00 | 20000.00 | 0.5 |

**Worked.** Crop input spend of 12600.00 standing accrued for a fiscal year counts as nothing on the first line, as 6300.00 on the second, and as 12600.00 on the third. Membership and Patronage Equity takes the capital retain on the volume that so counts.
